parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of a trashcan, made of rubber, typically located at the bottom front area. It is small and designed to be pressed by foot.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pedal that activates the lid-opening mechanism when pressed by the user’s foot.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or lever mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, circular and slightly convex in shape, covering the top opening.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the trashcan to contain odors and conceal waste, opening automatically or via the foot pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts upward around a hinge when the pedal is pressed, then closes by gravity or spring action.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, forming the container that holds waste.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage volume for waste and supports the lid and pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the structural base for the entire trashcan.
